summary: Frontend testing for API call deduplication changes. All features tested successfully: login with WIF key, feed page, desktop sidebar with ChatsPage, /chats desktop placeholder, profile page, settings with IPFS status, storefront, discover, and contacts pages. No console errors related to dedupFetch or useIpfsStatus singleton hook.

issues: React hydration warning: nested button elements detected in some components

critical_code_review_comments: dedupFetch.js: Correctly implements TTL cache (3s) and in-flight request deduplication for GET requests
useIpfsStatus.js: Singleton pattern using useSyncExternalStore - only one poll interval runs regardless of component count
App.js: ChatsPage double-mount prevention working - uses isDesktop state to conditionally render
useFollows.js: Uses dedupGet for user-state API calls
useDMNotifications.js: Uses dedupGet for DM threads API calls
useAuth.js: Uses dedupGet for profile lookup
FeedPage.js: Uses dedupGet for profile image fetch
context_for_next_testing_agent: API call deduplication changes verified. Key implementations: (1) useIpfsStatus singleton hook using useSyncExternalStore - one poll interval shared across all consumers, (2) dedupGet wrapper in dedupFetch.js provides 3-second TTL cache and concurrent request deduplication, (3) ChatsPage no longer double-mounts on desktop - App.js uses isDesktop state check. All navigation flows working. Console shows some 504 errors from external APIs but no errors related to dedup changes.
